title: Cost sentinel: delegated routing with provisional reserves and variant degradation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a tenant-level "cost sentinel" that delegates routing decisions to a policy engine which combines: (1) short-term provisional on-demand reserves (provisional_reserve) to avoid immediate application errors during spot evictions, (2) per-tenant soft budget token bucket, and (3) automated degradation to validated cheaper model variants (quantized/short-sequence variants) when budgets approach cap. This ticket scopes the core control-plane changes, runtime routing hooks, and a minimal console surface for visibility and overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Routing policy can allocate a provisional_reserve for a tenant that holds up to X GPU-minutes for emergency on-demand fallbacks
When a tenant's spend token-bucket hits the soft cap, 90% of requests are routed to cheaper model variants within 2s decision latency
End-to-end 95th percentile latency regression vs baseline <= 10% for degraded flows
Demoable console tile showing live provisional_reserve usage, token-bucket level, and fallback ratio
Canary rollout on 5 tenants with configuration knobs and automated rollback on SLA violations
implementation_steps: Spec policy DSL for provisional_reserve, token-bucket thresholds, and variant-degradation rules
Add provisional_reserve table to routing store (sharded by tenant) and a short-lived lease allocator
Extend router to consult cost-sentinel service synchronously with 200ms budget for decisioning; return route target and variant
Implement fallback-variant registry with compatibility metadata (max_seq_len, kv_cache_compat, tokenizer parity)
Instrument metrics: provisional_reserve_used_gpu_minutes, token_bucket_level, fallback_rate_by_tenant, latency_by_variant
Build minimal console view and API for overrides (tenant admin can increase reserve or pin on-demand), guarded by RBAC
Write automated integration test harness using synthetic spot eviction events and verify graceful failover
Run perf benchmark on dedicated cluster (A100, H100, and mixed T4/GPU types) to tune thresholds
